### (a) Social posts

1. We believe that if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will make every government more effective. Better tools for understanding problems will mean better tools for solving them.

2. We stand for more effective government everywhere. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will deliver that progress: stronger planning, smarter coordination and better public services.

3. We see a clear path to better government. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, every government will become more effective at turning knowledge and resources into action.

### (b) Newsletter opening

We believe that if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will make every government more effective. We see this as a transformation in what public institutions can accomplish: understanding complex problems, coordinating resources and delivering services with greater precision. Across every country, governments face decisions that demand more knowledge, more foresight and more capacity than their existing systems provide. Superintelligent AI will expand all three. We want this promise at the centre of the public conversation—not as a distant curiosity, but as a concrete reason to prepare. We stand for a future in which every government has stronger tools to turn public priorities into effective action.
